|strategy=By Tim Lau<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/hoth/light/small/duallasercannon.html</ref>

Are you like me, always having trouble taking out Walkers? Well look no furthur, this may not win every battle, but it sure makes the Dark Side think twice about Walkers. Use Dual Laser Cannons in combination with a [[Power Harpoon]]. Trip the Walker with the harpoon, now that the Walker's armor is 2, use Dual Lasers to finish it off. This method works well because the Dark Side has to lose everyone that is on board, and they might have trouble mounting an effective second strike. If they no longer have Walkers, use the [[Dual Laser Cannon]], preferably on [[Rogue 1]] or 3 with matching gunners, to shoot people who are camping outside.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-duallasercannon-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Dual Laser Cannon]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Dual Laser Cannon (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to Decipher's errata wording, the same words as [[Dual Laser Cannon (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “Use 2 Force to deploy on your T-47. May target a character, creature or vehicle using 1 Force. Draw destiny. Subtract 1 if targeting a character or creature. Add 2 if targeting a vehicle. Target hit if total destiny > defense value.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Dual Laser Cannon” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
